claims.statement: Tom Allen's concert hall was at 619 Market street.
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired phasipion pugilist of the world, 619 Market street.

claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised a concert every evening at his concert hall, with only the best singers engaged (printed as 'ee coneert', so 'Free' is a guess).
claims.excerpt: 619 Market street. ee coneert every evening. Best of singers only engaged here.

claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised himself as the retired pugilist of the world (printed as 'phasipion pugilist', so the word is unclear).
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired phasipion pugilist of the world

notes: Repeated advertisement; the Shamrock and wrestling items on the page are not about Allen.
